facts.fact: The NCRST authors state Namibia lacks comprehensive data protection and cybersecurity legislation and frameworks for AI governance.

NAM.note: Document states no government body using AI.

facts.fact: Through the Science Granting Councils Initiative the NCRST has funded projects on AI-powered tools for early disease detection, per the NCRST authors citing SGCI 2024.

NAM.note: Only a proposed national AI institute with no named builder or funder, and computing listed as a next step.
No hub or park described; the AI institute and an NUST accelerator are mentioned without programme or cohort detail.
Nothing stated on digital-skills training for civil servants.
Only school-curriculum digital literacy and AI degrees are stated; no public programme or measured share of adults.
